main_text.p: 1. Lex de pœnâ furti, quod eft plagium, abigeatus, sacrilegium &c. fimplex vel violentum. Exod. 21. v. 17. c. 22. v. 1. 2. 4. Deut. 24. v. 7.
2. Lex de fodiente & non cooperiente cisternam. Exod. 21. v. 33.
3. Lex de boue cornupetâ damnum dante proximo. Exod. 21. v. 35.
4. Lex de immiffo iumento in agrum alterius. Exod. 22. verf. 5.
4. Lex de igni, quo aliquis læfit agrum proximi fui. Exod. 22. v. 6.
5. Lex de boue aut asino inimici reducendo. Exod. 23. v. 4. Deut. 22. v. 1.
7. Lex de depositò. Exod. 22. verf. 7. 9. 10. Levit. 6. verf. 2. Num. 5. v. 6.
8. Lex de iusto & iniusto pondere & mensurâ. Levit. 19. v. 35. Deut. 25. v. 13.
9. Lex de non transferendo terminos. Deut. 19. ver. 14. & [?] 27. v. 17.

page.notes: The right-margin marks "10", "ij" and the mark "ʃ" beside line 20 are uncertain; the "9" after "21.v." in line 17 is doubtful. The "ʃ" after line 20 is probably a bracket or reference sign. Small reference marks in the right margin, beside items 2, 4, 6 and 9, are too faint to read and are not transcribed. The sign after "Deut. 19. ver. 14." is doubtful and is marked [?]. The last line is set short at the right and continues beyond what is visible.
